{{Quote|We're escaped slaves. I was able to get the ones you see here out, but there are many more still inside.|[[Kyran Silene]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TtB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Talk to Bandor|Corellia}}</ref>}}
The '''Corellian Slaver Bunker''' was a building located near the city of [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]], on the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], and used as the headquarters of the [[Corellian slavers]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|Well they are all over Tyrena, but the base is just northwest of the city. It's locked down pretty tight. [...] Once you get in look for a slave named Noro, he might be able to help you get to the bunker's lower levels.|Kyran Silene, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TtB" />}}
The Corellian Slaver Bunker was an underground base and prison used by the Corellian slavers by the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Dozens and dozens of Corellian persons were captured and enslaved in the bunker.<ref name="SWG:IE" /> It included [[Kyran Silene]],<ref name="SWG:IE" /> [[Noro Bok]] and [[Akkus Meik]],<ref name="SWG:IE" /> [[Anyza Ekull]],<ref name="SWG:S">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Slavemaster|Corellia}}</ref> [[Gordo Zek]], [[Zorgom Z'all|Zorgom]], [[Norith Z'all|Norith]] and [[Neeka Z'all]],<ref name="SWG:FC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Forgotten Child" on Corellia</ref> [[Bannoc G'noc]] and [[Narlissa]],<ref name="SWG:LL">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Love Lost" on Corellia</ref> [[Vermon Skeetz]], [[Dulor Norr]] and [[Akers Radch]].<ref name="SWG:PR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Petty Resolve|Corellia}}</ref>

[[File:Corellian_Slaver_Bunker_2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Slaves in the bunker.]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a group of slaves that included Anyza Ekull,<ref name="SWG:S" /> Zorgom and Norith Z'all,<ref name="SWG:FC" /> Bannoc G'noc,<ref name="SWG:LL" /> and Vermon Skeetz,<ref name="SWG:PR" /> and led by Kyran Silene managed to escape the slaver bunker. They did not reach Tyrena and were forced to establish a camp in the wilderness.<ref name="SWG:IE" />

In the meantime, Kyran Silene's wife, [[Madison Silene]], recruited a spacer to investigate the disappearance of her husband. After killing [[Faye Patrick]], one of the slavers, the spacer managed to find the camp and the escaped slaves.<ref name="SWG:TtB" /> The spacer agreed to help the former slaves and moved to the Corellian Slaver Bunker. The spacer fought several guards but successfully infiltrated the bunker. With the help of several slaves, the spacer managed to access the depth of the bunker,<ref name="SWG:IE" /> and even killed the slavemaster.<ref name="SWG:S" /> The spacer finally sliced the bunker's main computer. Using the bunker's own communications array, the spacer broadcasted the slavers' records on the CorSec emergency request channels.<ref name="SWG:IE" /> Dozens of CorSec agents quickly moved to the slaver bunker and freed all the slaves.<ref name="SWG:HbtKS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Head back to Kyran Silene|Corellia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Corellian Slaver Bunker was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:IE" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Corellian Slaver Bunker was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
